_comment: The only ports the port checker will test (TCP). Port 25 is excluded: Cloudflare Workers prohibit outbound connections to port 25. UDP-only services (e.g. WireGuard 51820) can't be tested with a TCP connection and are left out.

ports.label: FTP
ports.why: File transfer servers. Old and unencrypted; rarely worth exposing.

ports.label: SSH
ports.why: Remote command-line access to servers and NAS boxes.

ports.label: HTTP
ports.why: Web servers, and certificate checks for many home servers.

ports.label: HTTPS
ports.why: Encrypted web servers and many self-hosted apps.

ports.label: Remote Desktop
ports.why: Windows Remote Desktop. Risky to expose directly; a VPN is safer.

ports.label: HTTP (alternative)
ports.why: Web apps and proxies that don't use port 80.

ports.label: HTTPS (alternative)
ports.why: Admin panels and apps that don't use port 443.

ports.label: Minecraft (Java)
ports.why: The default port for Minecraft Java Edition servers.

ports.label: Plex
ports.why: Remote access to a Plex Media Server.
